x: DARREN MEAD - Age 20 years Darren Mead is a legend in his own young life time.

Matthew Stickles, Darren Mead and Justin Chaston ran superbly and are certain to pull each other through to many successes in the future. Steve Webster carried a heavy burden as 4th scorer in such a team, but he performed with great credit to clinch second place for Belgrave, only 4 points behind the winners.

Darren Mead partnered Chris in the 1500m and both gave very good accounts of themselves. Femi Abejide made his debut as a Belgrave man on his former "home track" and made a vast difference to our "jumps" section.
Darren Mead and Matthew Stickles chase Newham's Julien Gentry for the medals.
Darren Mead ran one of the fastest legs to bring Belgrave into 2nd place in the Reigate Priory relays - despite going off course. Mike Hayes missed the start of the Southern C.C.

What a tremendous feeling to see the club spirit running so high as members of both teams were eager to see each other times. Nice to see new Junior member Darren Mead running our second fastest time.

John Regis and Marcus Adam should look out for the name Adam Obeng in about 15 years time. Our somewhat belated best wishes go to Donna and Darren Mead on their wedding. They have moved back to Norfolk where they have set up home.
Darren Mead was a fine winner of thr Junior title. Justin Chaston was well positioned in 25th place.
